ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram includes a bottom-middle box labeled “Tualang” and a nearby box labeled “Dawn Bat.” The arrow between them starts at Tualang and points toward Dawn Bat, showing that the bat feeds on or depends on Tualang. Reasoning: If all the bats die, that consumer/dependent organism is removed, so fewer Tualang are eaten or used by bats. Therefore, the Tualang population would increase.
